author: Nintendo of America
description:
Woodo releases September 16, 2026 on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch! Pre-order now: https://ninten.do/6002aRZoe 

Assemble wooden scenes piece-by-piece in this cozy diorama puzzle game! As you place objects in their correct spots, each scene comes to life, revealing charming animations and small surprises.
